+def pixel_to_base(obs, u: int, v: int, camera: str = CAM) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Back-project one depth pixel using the frame's OpenCV calibration."""
+    info = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(info["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    E = np.asarray(info["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    z = float(obs.last_depth[camera][v, u])
+    cam_xyz = np.array([(u - K[0, 2]) * z / K[0, 0],
+                        (v - K[1, 2]) * z / K[1, 1], z])
+    return np.linalg.solve(E[:, :3], cam_xyz - E[:, 3])
+
+
+def _tcp_now(r: Robot) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)[8:15]

+def move_pose(r: Robot, xyz, quat=Q_DOWN, grip=0, spacing=0.008,
+              hold_rows=0, note=""):
+    """Follow a straight fingertip-frame path from current measured TCP pose."""
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    start = now[8:11]
+    start_q = now[11:15]
+    xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+    quat = np.asarray(quat, dtype=float)
+    # For the overhead grasps we retain the current down orientation.  If a
+    # future target changes it, interpolate normalized quaternions smoothly.
+    if np.dot(start_q, quat) < 0:
+        quat = -quat
+    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz - start))
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / spacing)))
+    rows = []
+    for i in range(1, n + 1):
+        f = i / n
+        p = start * (1.0 - f) + xyz * f
+        q = start_q * (1.0 - f) + quat * f
+        q /= np.linalg.norm(q)
+        rows.append([*p, *q, float(grip)])
+    rows.extend([[*xyz, *quat, float(grip)]] * int(hold_rows))
+    arr = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+    out = []

def pick_place(r: Robot, name: str, xy, grasp_z: float,
               bin_xy=BIN_XY, lift_z=0.44):
    """Open overhead pinch, close, lift, carry above the bin, then release."""
    x, y = map(float, xy)
    # Approach from above, descend to the upper body, then allow the Robotiq
    # fingers to close for one second before assessing the grasp.
    move_pose(r, [x, y, 0.30], grip=0, note=f"{name}: hover")
    move_pose(r, [x, y, grasp_z], grip=0, note=f"{name}: descend")
    move_pose(r, [x, y, grasp_z], grip=1, hold_rows=15, note=f"{name}: close")
    obs = inspect(r, f"{name}_grasp")
    opening = float(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][24])
    print("GRIPPER_OPENING", name, opening, flush=True)
    if opening < 0.010:
        print("GRASP_NOT_CONFIRMED; holding position for inspection", flush=True)
        return obs
    # Continue the planned lift.  A held object makes the measured opening
    # remain above the empty closed value; images provide a second check.
    move_pose(r, [x, y, lift_z], grip=1, note=f"{name}: lift")
    move_pose(r, [0.45, -0.08, lift_z], grip=1, note=f"{name}: carry-mid")
    move_pose(r, [float(bin_xy[0]), float(bin_xy[1]), lift_z], grip=1,
              note=f"{name}: above-bin")
    # Release well above the bin rim; the object falls into its open convex hull.
    move_pose(r, [float(bin_xy[0]), float(bin_xy[1]), lift_z], grip=0,
              hold_rows=15, note=f"{name}: release")
    return inspect(r, f"{name}_placed")


def main():
    task = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "remaining"
